label: Cocoa (ICE US CC) - regime-first, minute-fresh, thin-market aware

accuracyCeilings.weather: West African weather is the flagship minute-fresh driver and cannot be judged deterministically - moderate rain is bearish, excessive rain and drought are BOTH bullish. Declared, not executed.
accuracyCeilings.arrivals: Ivory Coast arrivals series conflict (CCC official vs exporter, ~100k+ tonnes) and base-year revisions distort y/y - requires named-series verification the engine cannot do.
accuracyCeilings.thinMarket: Cocoa OI is a fraction of pre-2024 levels; single orders and ICE margin changes move price independent of fundamentals. Bands are wide by construction.
accuracyCeilings.shortHorizon: No lean below catalyst granularity (Monday arrivals / Friday COT / grind print / verified weather).

qualitativeProtocols: WEATHER PROTOCOL: pull actual meteorology (Reuters Abidjan survey, NOAA ENSO), classify rain by intensity-vs-need, time-split current-crop vs next-crop. (Out of deterministic scope - declared, RED-FLAGGED.)
POLICY/INTERVENTION WATCH: CCC/Cocobod farmgate resets, floor-defense buying, withholding. (Declared.)
NARRATIVE-WHIPSAW detector: daily wraps flip sign day to day - treat as descriptions, never signals.
SYMBOL/VENUE guard: cocoa quotes collide across feeds (ICE US CC vs London C vs CFD) - every price needs exchange + contract + timestamp.
